description: Hermes Agent (NousResearch) learning-loop ideas adapted to Console Grok harness — no hermes CLI.

curated_memory.rule: Bounded, curated facts and process tips — not unbounded chat dumps. Prefer promote-to-harness over long MEMORY.

skill_creation.trigger: failure_class repeats >= promote_process_edit_after_repeats OR hard fail after complex multi-step task
skill_creation.rule: Draft skills from evidence; promote durable control into workflows/harness/tools (Bun doctrine).

skill_self_improve.trigger: same class recurs after skill draft exists
skill_self_improve.action: revise skill + patch failure-classes / workflow admit step

persist_nudge.message: Persist learnings: reflection tip skill trajectory before declaring done.

session_search.rule: Cross-session recall before inventing process folklore.

trajectory.rule: Compress what failed, what process changed, evidence pointers — not full transcripts.

map_to_console.soft_red_silence: ops.soft-red-silence — never leave soft reds unowned
